item.title: Mangohood Direct Kids Kitchen Standing Towers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury and Death from Entrapment and Fall Hazards; Imported by Hangzhou Xinyanchuangxin
item.company: Online at Amazon.com from July 2025 through March 2026 for between $57 and $67.
item.brand: Online at Amazon.com from July 2025 through March 2026 for between $57 and $67.
item.product: Mangohood Direct Kids Kitchen Standing Towers, Model LT003
item.summary: This recall involves Mangohood Direct-branded children's tower stools, model LT003. The tower stools were sold in natural bamboo, gray, and white, and measure about 35 inches tall by 16 inches wide and 18 inches deep.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Mangohood Direct Kids Kitchen Standing Towers, Model LT003.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled tower stools immediately and store them away from children until repaired. Contact Hangzhou Xinyanchuangxin for repair parts, which include stabilizing feet and installation instructions. The firm will mail the repair parts directly to consumers free of charge.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
